description: This file defines the 'contextMenu' class, which manages context menu items, including adding items, loading from files and definitions, and generating JavaScript code to register the menu. It is part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically handling client-side context menu behavior.

classes.name: contextMenu
classes.description: Class that manages context menu items, including adding, loading, and generating scripts for client-side use.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the contextMenu class with an empty menu items list.

methods.name: getScript
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code to register the context menu object with its menu items.

methods.name: addMenuItem
methods.description: Adds a menu item to the context menu, with optional ACL access check.

methods.name: loadFromFile
methods.description: Loads menu items from an external PHP file based on a given object name.

methods.name: loadFromDef
methods.description: Loads menu items from a provided definitions array.
